main_text.p: Essena etiam in præfectura suburbanâ. Præterea Præpositurae,Præpositu-re: sacerdotii genus opimum & honoratum, à Monasteriensi PræsulePra-westdyk (Videinf.) ἰυ&ξίας[?] ac quietis causâ introdu-ctum in hæc loca, quatuor, Farmsuma-na, Loppershemia, Vsquerdia, Leensia: quinta in Hommertziis jamdudum extri-ta. Collegium quoque canonicorum,Canonici, aut ut tum vulgò loquendi mos habebat, ecclesia collegiata apud Bedumanos cum fano ibidem illustri, supra fanorum ru-sticorum modum; cui primus sacerdos non temerè alius, quàm aut genere aut doctrinae titulo conspicuus solet dari, magno honore atque autoritate in populo. Denique pastura Baffloa in Hunes-Pastu-ræ,goniis, itemque Middelsthemia, vicario munere pro Monasteriensi olim decorate. Nec ad hæc, quod mireris, Regum aut Principum liberalitas quicquam contulit, sed rusticæ plebis studia, pauco-rumque nobilium ista sanè, quàm pro re ac agri modo majora congesêre.

page.notes: The Greek word after "Præsule" is uncertain and marked [?]. The bold note "Pra-westdyk" is set in black letter and its first letters are uncertain. The last line of this part is cut off in the scan, so the sentence continues beyond it. The printed page number "B 4" is a signature. The right-margin note "Pastu-ræ," is uncertain: the scan shows "Pasto-" with "ræ," or "rae," at the line end, so "Pastu-" may be misread. The note "Arces sae-" is partly blurred. The printed "Hunef-" is long s and is given as "Hunes-". The word "congesêre" has a doubtful accent.
